semantics.types: General angles: all pixel layers and unstyled groups, hidden/off-artboard included. Generated/adjustment/active style/frozen style reference reject before sampling. Exact quarter turns delegate full-type image.orient.
semantics.sampling: Independent inverse-center nearest references at 27/-27/45/137.5 degrees in 8/16 bit; independent premultiplied linear-light bilinear reference. Near-edge ties within 1e-9 choose positive-side sample consistently for pixels and masks.
semantics.frame: Conservative half-source-pixel reconstruction envelope, same frame for nearest and bilinear; top-left remains fixed. Original off-artboard source is not clipped.
semantics.history: One atomic cancellable edit, exact archive undo and project roundtrip; whole revolutions have no revision/dirty/history/current-layer changes.
semantics.limits: Existing output/source-cache/coordinate/shared-budget limits and actual computation cancellation verified.
